Emm..., personally, I revised the notebook from the "Simplified submission approach" (great, great thanks to the author saving me out of the submission failure, it's quite painful for an amateur), and the LLM loading part is adapted from the AIMO3 public notebook.
- As gpt-oss-20b is a text based model, so the first problem is let it "see" the game frame: I am trying to adapted the solution from the "RGB-Agent" project: <https://github.com/alexisfox7/RGB-Agent/tree/main>, as I remembered, they are the winner of the preview stage of ARC-AGI-3 at 2025. Their genius idea is transform the frame data into ASCII format and logging with progress data in a log file, then LLM will act as an advisor to read the file and instruct the agent to work on.
- The multimodal part, I had just test Qwen3 vl and Qwen 3.6, the very first suggestion is not simply compare two game frame directly, the model will get some illusion reason or attention omission problem to fail of detecting the moving object.
